follow_ups.title: Make the save migration chain actually chain, and put the player's basket under the gateway checker
follow_ups.first_action: Turn the early returns in SaveGame.migrate into a loop over version steps, then add a test that carries playtests/2026-08-21_103100/autosave.json through two migrations and checks its contents, not just that it loaded.
follow_ups.why: The next save version silently mis-loads every version-1 file, and the static check that guards world state does not watch the player's economy at all — both are guards that would miss exactly this change.

follow_ups.title: Write harvest-as-seed into the farming design doc
follow_ups.first_action: Draft the section: one basket instead of two stores, selling only what is over the line, the limit raised later by storage, what happens to a harvest when the basket is full, and where a bot's harvest goes when the player is full.
follow_ups.why: The design doc is the source of intent and the code change has to cite it, and the bot-harvest and overflow rules are decisions somebody has to make before anyone writes the code.

follow_ups.title: Merge the two stores into one basket and add a sell-the-overflow verb
follow_ups.first_action: Change the harvest branch of the gateway to deposit into the planting store, add the new selling verb beside the existing one rather than redefining it, and bump the save format with a step that folds the old crop store into the basket.
follow_ups.why: This is the change itself, and it is the half that touches the gateway, the save format and what a player sees.

follow_ups.title: Mark the replay corpus boundary before the rules change
follow_ups.first_action: Record which shelved sessions and which build stamps predate harvest-as-seed, and state whether pre-change sessions stay in the phase-4 training set or are held aside.
follow_ups.why: Sessions recorded before the change are play under different rules, and once the change lands nothing in the files themselves says so.

recommend.question: Do we make harvested plants the seed stock now, or wait and fold it into the storage and ammo economy next milestone?
recommend.answer: Do it now, and let anything over the carry limit fall into the shipping bin and pay out overnight.
recommend.why: The recorded sessions this would reinterpret have already stopped verifying, so the price of the change will never be lower than it is today — and the bin already exists, is already saved and already pays, so overflow needs no new screen and a tap on a ripe crop never refuses a child.
recommend.instead: A full basket refuses the harvest and the crop stays ripe in the ground, which teaches scarcity harder and makes the grain silo matter more, at the cost of a tap that visibly does nothing.
